title: TripStarted
description: The Driver started a Dispatched Trip on its day, so it is In progress (Canonical Model event, version 1). From now on the Planner can change the Trip only by taking off a Shipment that isn't collected. Published on the Trip events topic, under the correlation ID of the Driver's Start Trip action; the Trip number traces the Trip.

occurredAt.description: When the TMS recorded the start.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID of the Driver's Start Trip action.

version.description: The Trip's version when it started. Starting doesn't change it.

driverId.description: The Driver who started the Trip: the Trip's Driver.
